patch_description: Crossover combining the best elements of both programs: (1) the vectorized batched k-worst-triplet polish from the faster parent, (2) the analytic perpendicular "escape direction" candidates from the current program (which gave the best score 0.49), and (3) a new hybrid loop that alternates local polish with additional SLSQP soft-min re-refinement passes seeded from the polished configuration. This lets the smooth-min optimizer escape basins the pure polish gets stuck in, while the polish repairs the sharp min-area that SLSQP's soft-min underestimates. The final configuration always passes feasibility projection, and all randomness is seeded for determinism.
